incident_text: A big fire is burning on this street tonight.

result.scene_summary: A nighttime view of a narrow street lined with traditional brick buildings featuring illuminated windows and external lighting.

observations.description: Brick buildings with white-framed windows and doors.
Outdoor wall-mounted street lamps lit at night.
Flower boxes with red flowers on the building facades.
Green foliage visible in a planter or bush near the street.
Dark, empty street with no visible traffic or pedestrians.
Reflections of light on the pavement and buildings.
